pool.text: The commune placed itself under the protection of the Counts of Savoy.
Duke Emmanuel Philibert abolished Latin and established Italian as the official language.
Opening ports and proclaiming full freedom of trade gave great stimulus to commerce.
Giuseppe Garibaldi was born in Nice during the Napoleonic Empire period.
The French named the promenade La Promenade des Anglais during this year.
The county was definitively ceded to France following the Treaty of Turin.
The observatory was established by the banker Raphaël Bischoffsheim in Nice.
A large refractor telescope became operational at the newly established observatory.
The Tramway de Nice electrified its horse-drawn streetcars and spread its network.
Prince Arthur inaugurated the city's main promenade following its refurbishment.
Jews of foreign origin were rounded up and interned in the Auvare barracks.
American paratroopers entered the city and Nice was finally liberated.
A landslide and an undersea slide caused two tsunamis that hit Nice.
European leaders met to negotiate and sign the Treaty of Nice.
The new Tramway de Nice linked the northern and eastern suburbs.
A truck was deliberately driven into a crowd of people by an attacker.
Charles III received honorary citizenship of Nice during a ceremony.
A stabbing attack killed three people at the local Notre-Dame de Nice.
UNESCO proclaimed Nice a World Heritage Site as a winter resort town.
Seven people from the same family were killed in an arson attack.
